node.statement: By lem-routef-raw-factor-setting-formation, the fields of W_RF are one fixed package independent of H, Phi, eta, dimension, amplification level, and block data. Direct serial expansion of (1.1)-(1.5) in def-routef-raw-factor-setting uses only finite real sums, products, maxima, minima, and reciprocals with positive denominators, so C_theta, C_Delta, C_Upsilon, and C_2 are finite and input-independent. Consequently all four entries in the maximum (1.6) are finite and input-independent, and their finite maximum K is finite and universal.
